rows.current_selected_system_description: RARG (Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent, relevance-ordered traversal) on GPT-5.4-mini at medium reasoning, with llama-nv-embed-reasoning-3b as retriever, arXiv:2607.24223 Table 3 row 'RARG' = 51.75, code LeqsNaN/RARG. CHANGED FROM RARG+ (53.36) BY OWNER RULING 2026-09-16 ('那就改比RARG'), and this is a reproducibility limit, not a downgrade of ambition: RARG+ adds query-relevant entry-point paragraphs, and the code that produces them was never published -- model_server.py:362-363 imports paragraph_splitter from RARG/qr_head_discovery, which is absent from the clone, from this host and from upstream main at 58ba60e, while pyproject declares only ordinary PyPI packages and setup.sh fetches nothing. The paper describes the mechanism in one sentence, too little to rebuild. Its absence is also silent: the call site at :473 sits inside a try/except that logs '[WARN] paragraph rerank (emb) failed, skipping', so the RARG+ wrapper would have scored with RARG's behaviour under RARG+'s name. RARG++ (50.55) is a third, distinct row and is not used.
rows.caveat: Current executable comparator is RARG (51.75), replacing RARG+ (53.36); the RARG+ entry-point implementation was not released. Published sampling protocol is unstated.

rows.current_selected_system_description: CacheRAG (Sun & Chen, HKUST; arXiv:2604.26176v4; code ysunbp/CacheRAG-code @db58ba5f5cfdde70ea64080f0a5fc3020d48449e), its 578 RELEASED per-item answers (output/crag/full-backup-{head,torso,tail}-test-eval.jsonl) re-graded by THIS deployment's grader with judge Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct: truthfulness 0.3893, accuracy 0.6401, hallucination 0.2509, missing 0.1090, n=578 (370 correct / 145 hallucinated / 63 missing). Reproduced exactly across two independent runs. CacheRAG's PUBLISHED Table 1 row is 0.824 accuracy / 0.112 hallucination / 0.064 missing / 0.711 truthfulness; that was produced by CacheRAG's own scorer, whose line 161 marks an item correct whenever the gold string is a SUBSTRING of the answer -- 321/578 = 55.5% of its items were decided that way, against 0/578 for the official rule it claims to follow. 0.711 IS NOT THE BAR. The comparator was not re-run; only its released answers were re-graded, which is why its placeholder API credentials and 4x A100 requirement do not block this build.
rows.caveat: Retained pre-retrieved-KG variant: truthfulness 329/578 = 0.5692 (435 correct, 106 hallucinations, 37 missing). The old 577 denominator wrongly excluded a valid empty-answer zero. The benchmark mock-API arm and aligned-judge comparison remain pending; paper 0.711 is not the local regrade 0.3893.
